cutoff.meaning: The deadline for the registrar to have released the transcript.

negative_condition: The transcript has not been released by the deadline, or the release occurs at or after the deadline.
positive_condition: The registrar has actually released the official transcript before the deadline.

proof.meaning: The registrar's system record showing the release timestamp of Amara Osei's official transcript.
proof.name: transcript_release_record
proof.subject: Amara Osei's transcript

terminal_meaning: Whether the Wexford State University registrar has released Amara Osei's official transcript before 12:00 noon Central on Monday 8 June 2026.
